_comment: Bridge traffic: any event with a proxy tag (ActivityPub, RSS, web protocol bridges — not just Mostr)
momostr: L=pink.momostr label namespace (relay recommendation bot)
Ditto Trends Service: L=pub.ditto.trends label namespace (automated trend labeling, not the Ditto client itself)
bitbot AI agent: L=ai.agent with l=bitbot labels
Snort: NIP-89 client tag (3-element with 31990 address)
Damus: simple 2-element client tag (user-configurable, default enabled)
Amethyst: simple client tag without NIP-89 31990 reference
Primal Android (KMP): client tag on ALL events
Primal Web: client tag ONLY on article drafts (kind 31023); note lowercase hyphenated value
Primal iOS (KMP target): client tag on ALL events via Kotlin Multiplatform
Primal iOS (native Swift): client tag ONLY on live comments (kind 1311); note hyphenated value
Primal Desktop (KMP target): client tag on ALL events
